changes: Online class schedule with Live badge — set meeting days, time, and link per course. A green LIVE pill appears on the tile during class, with a 15-minute countdown before it starts.
Eight color themes — Default, Cipher, Castorice, Hyacine, Cerydra, Hysilens, Mydei, Anaxa. Each with its own light/dark variant and a satisfying wave transition between them.
Custom profile avatar — upload any photo, auto-cropped to a circle. Cosmetic only, stored locally on your device.
Smooth slide-open for What's New — announcements expand inline with the classes column riding the same height change.
Bell ring animation paired with the cog spin — friendly click acknowledgments on both notification and settings buttons.
Old course data cleanup — Settings → Data has a new Scan button to remove schedules and photos from courses no longer in your list.
No more white flash on dark-mode reloads — the theme now applies before first paint.
Plenty of polish — fixed the course peek occasionally flying to the corner, removed a stuck-hover glow on Up Next cards, friendlier urgency indicators, and a long list of smaller fixes.
Major internal refactor — dashboard.js split into modular UI files. Invisible to you, but means future updates ship faster and cleaner.
